title: CatalogRevisionEntity
responsibility: Stores revision-to-entity membership in catalog_revision_entities through a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: CatalogRevisionEntity.id
inputs.description: The caller-supplied row identifier stored as the table primary key and used by find, update, and delete. The model forwards it unchanged and does not generate or validate its format.

inputs.name: CatalogRevisionEntity.commit
inputs.description: Git commit identifier associated with this revision-to-entity row. The model treats it as an opaque required string and does not parse or validate a hash format.

inputs.name: CatalogRevisionEntity.entityId
inputs.description: Identifier of the catalog entity associated with the revision. The model treats it as an opaque required string and does not resolve the entity or validate the identifier format.

outputs.name: CatalogRevisionEntity.find
outputs.description: Resolved result of looking up the supplied row identifier in catalog_revision_entities, or null when the adapter reports no row. The model forwards the adapter result without checking row contents.

outputs.name: CatalogRevisionEntity.findBy
outputs.description: Resolved list returned by the adapter for the supplied partial attribute filters. The model shallow-copies the filters but leaves matching, ordering, and pagination semantics to the adapter.

outputs.name: CatalogRevisionEntity.create
outputs.description: Resolved row returned by the adapter after creation from complete id, commit, and entityId attributes. The model shallow-copies and forwards the input, leaving validation and persistence behavior to the adapter.

outputs.name: CatalogRevisionEntity.update
outputs.description: Resolved updated row, or null according to the adapter result, for the supplied row identifier and patch. The patch may include commit and entityId only; the model does not define merge or missing-row behavior.

outputs.name: CatalogRevisionEntity.delete
outputs.description: Boolean result returned by the adapter after deletion of the row identified by id. The model does not define whether false means the row was absent or another adapter-specific outcome.

errors.name: Adapter or copied-field error
errors.description: A synchronous adapter exception or rejected adapter promise propagates without a wrapper. Shallow copies in findBy, create, and update can also trigger a caller-supplied getter exception before the adapter call.
